renderings.value: Expresses 'when' or 'in case of' specific situations or timings.
The ～折には grammar point is used to emphasize a specific moment or situation (often not very frequent). It can be translated as 'when (the occasion arises)' or 'in case of'.
Verb-dictionary form + 折には, Verb-た form + 折には, い-Adjective + 折には, な-Adjective + な折には, Noun + の折には
Formal, literary, ceremonial "on the occasion of". (Near-duplicate of n1-240's 折に, with は added.)
Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
When you get thirsty, please drink water from this bottle.
When you visit this area, make sure to go to this shrine.
If he doesn't seem well, please ask if he's feeling sick.
When you have an opportunity, act without hesitation.
